collection.title: VIIRS/JPSS2 BRDF/Albedo NBAR at Solar Noon Band M5 Daily L3 Global 30ArcSec CMG V002
collection.summary: The NOAA-21 Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF) and Albedo Nadir BRDF-Adjusted Reflectance (NBAR) for Band M5 (VJ243D84) is produced daily using 16 days of data at 30 arc second (1,000 meter) resolution. Data are temporally weighted to the ninth day, which is reflected in the file name. The VJ243D product suite is provided in a Climate Modeling Grid (CMG), which covers the entire globe for use in climate simulation models. Due to the large file size, each VJ243D product contains just one data layer. VJ243D80 through VJ243D89 are the NBAR products of the VJ243D BRDF/Albedo product suite. NBAR values are provided for the nine VIIRS moderate resolution bands (M1 through M5, M7, M8, M10, and M11) included in the [VJ243MA4](https://doi.org/10.5067/VIIRS/VJ243MA4.002) product. In addition to the bands included in VJ243MA4, this product suite includes NBAR values for the VIIRS Day/Night Band (DNB). The NBAR algorithm removes view angle effects from directional reflectances to model the values as if they were collected from a nadir view at local solar noon. Details regarding methodology are available on the VJ243MA4 product page and in the Algorithm Theoretical Basis Document (ATBD). VNP43D84 is the NBAR for VIIRS band M5 (0.672 μm). Known Issues * For complete information about known issues please refer to the [MODIS/VIIRS Land Quality Assessment website](https://landweb.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/knownissue?sensor=VIIRS&sat=J2&as=5200).

documentation.description: The LDOPE Land Product Quality Assessment website provides known issues, maneuvers, and product quality of the land products.
The technical information in the User's Guide enables users to interpret and use the data products.
The ATBD provides physical theory and mathematical procedures for the calculations used to produce the data products.
The File Specification provides a description of the product file including Scientific Data Sets and their attributes.
Validation at stage 3 has been achieved for the VIIRS BRDF/Albedo product suite.
Further details regarding VIIRS product validation and maturity status are available from VIIRS Land Product Quality Assessment site.
